manifest.name: Quick Note
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Adds a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+N) to quickly create a new card with a timestamp title

css: .quick-note-indicator { position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; background: rgba(0,123,255,0.9); color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; z-index: 9999; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; pointer-events: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,123,255,0.3); } .quick-note-indicator.show { opacity: 1; } body.dark-theme .quick-note-indicator { background: rgba(100,150,255,0.9); }
